profile.headline: Data Engineer - Senior SWE - Senior DBA
profile.summary:
Strong skills in Data Analysis, Java programming, and Java Enterprise technologies (Struts, Spring, Hibernate, EJB...). High experience in Oracle PLSQL(indexes, procedures, packages, views, materialized views, etc..) , Oracle Reports(10g, 11g)  and Analytics. 

Experience in multi crossed platform programming such as Windows, Unix, Linux, Mac OS...

Skill in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)- Agile/ Waterfall methodology, Estimating and Requirements Analysis for data warehousing, Tolling Industries. 

Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry.

High Skilled Application Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the Information technology and services industry for 12 years. 

Strong engineering professional with a Engineer's degree focused in Computer Software Engineering from University of Technology, Da Nang, Viet Nam.
